solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Jogger is concerning carer

parts.note: re means concerning or about, as in business letters
a minder is someone who looks after a child or person

explanation.surface: A runner turns out to be a care worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jogger' looks like a runner, but it is the definition: something that jogs your memory.
explanation.definitionFit: A prompt that nudges the memory jogs it, so a jogger in this playful sense is a prompt.

clue.text: Managed large bag for plunder

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
a sack is a big bag of coarse cloth

explanation.surface: A thief ran off with a big bag of loot.
explanation.definitionFit: To ransack is to search a place thoroughly and rob it, so to plunder it.

clue.text: Cannibal's mother more tidy

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
neater means tidier

explanation.surface: A cannibal's mother is tidier than the cannibal.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who eats human flesh is literally an eater of people.

clue.text: Paint that makes dog sick

definitions.meaning: a water-based paint mixed with glue, used for scenery and walls

explanation.surface: Some paint makes the dog ill.
explanation.definitionFit: Distemper is both a glue-bound paint and a contagious canine illness.

clue.text: Fabulous bird eaten by crocodile

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the word crocodile, as if swallowed

explanation.surface: A legendary bird swallowed by a crocodile.
explanation.definitionFit: The roc is a giant mythical bird from the Arabian Nights tales.

clue.text: Passion displayed in theatre

indicators.note: the letters are on show inside the word theatre

explanation.surface: Strong emotion is on show on the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Heat is intensity of feeling, as in the heat of the moment, a synonym for passion.

clue.text: Smelly sort of bird?

definitions.meaning: British slang: giving off a strong bad odour
the first word of the name of a tiny nectar-feeding bird that hovers

explanation.surface: Asking whether a bird is the smelly kind.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang something that pongs is said to hum.
explanation.definitionFit: Humming is slang for stinking, and the hummingbird is named for its whirring wings.

clue.text: A friend, married, gets pronounceable initials

parts.note: a crony is a close companion

explanation.surface: A wedded pal gets initials that can be said as a word.
explanation.definitionFit: An abbreviation made of initial letters and spoken as a word, like NATO, is this.

clue.text: Russian revolutionary backed, then beheaded in square

indicators.note: backed means the remaining letters are put in reverse order
beheaded means the revolutionary's name loses its first letter

parts.note: Lenin led the Bolshevik revolution of 1917

explanation.surface: A Russian revolutionary is turned back and executed in a public square.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beheaded' drops the L from LENIN to give ENIN, and 'backed' turns that round. 'square' is a square number, not a public place.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine is three times three, a perfect square number.

clue.text: Tree on borders of Surrey appeared full of gold

indicators.note: the borders of a word are its first and last letters
one word holds the other within it

parts.note: came, as in came into view, means appeared
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: A tree in a Surrey garden looked golden.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is heraldry's word for gold, a crossword staple.
explanation.definitionFit: The sycamore is a common broadleaf tree of the maple family.

clue.text: Totally unacceptable collection of articles by scholar

definitions.note: used predicatively, as in it is anathema to me

parts.note: the three English articles: an, a and the
MA, a Master of Arts, is a scholar

explanation.surface: A grammar textbook's article list dismissed by an academic as unacceptable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collection of' just gathers the three articles AN, A and THE together.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is anathema to you is detested and wholly beyond the pale.

clue.text: Possible designation of big match: everyone approves it, we hear

indicators.note: we hear signals words that sound like the phrase in the clue

parts.note: all for everyone, tick it for approves it

explanation.surface: A big game that all agree on.
explanation.walkthrough: To tick something is to mark it as approved, so ALL TICK IT is said aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: A sell-out game may be marked as admission by advance ticket only, with no pay-at-gate entry.

clue.text: No sound from horse is heard

indicators.note: is heard signals a word that sounds the same as the horse's call

parts.note: a neigh is the cry a horse makes

explanation.surface: No noise comes from the horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Nay is an old or formal word for a refusal, a negative vote.

clue.text: Nice farewell?

parts.note: Nice is the French Riviera city, so a farewell said there is in French

explanation.surface: A pleasant goodbye.
explanation.walkthrough: Nice at the start of the clue hides its capital: the city, not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: The French way of saying goodbye, till we meet again.

clue.text: Maintain part of castle in revolt

parts.note: the keep is a castle's central stronghold tower
up, as in up in arms, means in revolt

explanation.surface: Holding on to a section of a castle during an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something up is to continue or sustain it, a phrasal synonym.

clue.text: Record I restore to health a foodie

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
to cure is to heal

explanation.surface: A recording that cures a gourmet.
explanation.definitionFit: An epicure is a person who takes particular pleasure in fine food and drink.

clue.text: A system for selling Egyptian tomb

definitions.meaning: a scheme where sellers recruit others beneath them in tiers
the great stone monuments at Giza housing pharaohs

explanation.surface: A sales scheme run from an Egyptian tomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyramid selling is a tiered sales scheme, and Egyptian pharaohs were buried in pyramids.

clue.text: Bean say eaten by crazy mule

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other, as food goes into a mouth
crazy means the letters of mule are jumbled

parts.note: e.g., for example, is what say means here

explanation.surface: A mad mule gobbles up a bean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazy' rearranges the mule into LUME; 'say' signals an example, hence EG.
explanation.definitionFit: Beans are the seeds or pods of plants in the pea family, legumes.

clue.text: Swallow poisonous element or be shot

parts.note: to swallow food is to eat it
lead is a toxic metal, chemical symbol Pb

explanation.surface: Choose between swallowing a toxic metal or facing a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat lead is gangster slang for being hit by bullets.

clue.text: Poke nose into party regularly

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word party

explanation.surface: Someone nosing into a gathering from time to time.
explanation.definitionFit: To pry is to be nosy, to poke one's nose into other people's affairs.

clue.text: Perhaps buy more shares in control undergarment

parts.note: a rein is a strap for controlling a horse, hence control
a vest is a sleeveless undershirt in British usage

explanation.surface: Buying more shares in a company that makes control underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a vest is worn under a shirt, not the American waistcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: Putting profits back into stock, for example by buying further shares, is investing again.

clue.text: In bad visibility chap's finding Russian city

indicators.note: In puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: murk is gloom or fog that makes it hard to see
a chap is a man, so chap's gives man's

explanation.surface: A man navigating through fog finds himself in a Russian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Murmansk is a port city in Russia's Arctic north-west.

clue.text: Horse's name: Silver

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A horse is called Silver, like the Lone Ranger's.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', and Silver looks like the horse's name but gives the symbol AG.
explanation.definitionFit: A nag is an old or worn-out horse.

clue.text: Little rodent's new love

indicators.note: new means the letters of love are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A small rodent has found a new love.
explanation.definitionFit: A vole is a small mouse-like rodent, such as the water vole.

clue.text: Legal document that can be taken either way

definitions.note: a signed legal instrument such as a conveyance, whose four letters form a palindrome

indicators.text: that can be taken either way
indicators.note: the letters read the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: a signed legal instrument such as a conveyance, whose four letters form a palindrome

explanation.surface: A contract whose terms are ambiguous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken either way' sounds like ambiguous wording, but it means the word is a palindrome.
explanation.definitionFit: A deed is a signed legal instrument, such as one transferring property.

clue.text: Deduced the grade must be reviewed

indicators.note: reviewed suggests the letters of the grade are reworked into another order

explanation.surface: A student concludes their mark needs a second look.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather can mean to infer or understand from what one hears, as in I gather you were away.
